purpose: IFS Cloud cross-domain data, scale, schema and recovery review.

requiredPermissions: dedicated IFS service identity using Client Credentials
exact reviewed Read Only projection grants for the required Premium/Standard APIs
effective data-scope restriction for approved company/site/entity boundaries where required
approved customer-specific system URL and deployment region
separate customer-controlled setup for any optional Entity Service activation; steady-state ingestion remains read-only
dataAvailableOrExpected: shop orders, operations, routing/execution detail, planned dates, completed and scrap quantities where the reviewed manufacturing projections expose them
work centers, work center resources, labor classes, resource calendars/capacity and scheduling assignments
shop-floor employees, teams, operation clockings, labor/machine time and production reporting
skills, competencies, qualifications and certificates where the relevant HCM/resource capabilities are installed and exposed
maintenance work, equipment/assets, machine downtime and maintenance-related scheduling context where installed
quality/control-plan results, non-conformance and scrap/rework evidence where installed
parts/SKUs, inventory on hand/reserved/in-transit/available, material requirements, WIP and inventory movements
resource/work-center/labor/material/overhead costs, cost centres and finance/job-cost dimensions where exposed
custom fields and configuration/customization-layer projection fields visible to the reviewed identity
stableIdentifiers: preserve IFS native keys as source identifiers namespaced by connection, instance, company/site, projection, API version and dataset
preserve composite shop-order/operation keys and work-order/resource/part/site identifiers rather than assuming one globally unique numeric key
retain projection/API class/layer/version and schema fingerprint so release and customization changes cannot reinterpret history

freshnessLatency.rest: bounded WFM-controlled reads; record observed/effective/ingestion timestamps and measured latency
freshnessLatency.manufacturing: use provider-supported updated-time filters only where their semantics are established by the selected API; overlap replay and stable-id dedupe remain required
freshnessLatency.events: no generic event completeness claim is made for all IFS projections; polling/reconciliation remains authoritative

paginationDeltaEvents.pagination: discover per-projection paging from API Explorer/OpenAPI/OData metadata; require a continuous bounded page chain before advancing completeness
paginationDeltaEvents.delta: prefer documented updated-time or provider cursor semantics per projection; otherwise use bounded overlap windows and stable-id dedupe
paginationDeltaEvents.events: specific IFS Connect/middleware/event paths require separate route/security evidence
paginationDeltaEvents.reconciliation: filtered, incremental, permission-limited or partial reads never imply deletion; authoritative absence needs proven complete scope, pages and reconciliation

rateLimitsAndRetries: discover and measure the authorised tenant limits rather than assuming one universal public rate-limit contract
401/403 stop blind retry and enter identity/projection/data-scope diagnostics
429/retryable 5xx/network interruption use bounded backoff for idempotent reads while preserving checkpoint state
regional/site interruption or partial page failure requires overlap replay/reconciliation before affected data is treated as current
versionsRegionsCustomFields: API Explorer exposes API class, layer, deprecation and OpenAPI/OData metadata per projection
Premium API version handling retains an older projection version alongside a new version until the next release and publishes breaking-change guidance
custom fields can be exposed through IFS APIs; configuration/customization-layer changes require schema negotiation and extension provenance
multi-company, multi-site, multi-currency, locale, language, calendar, timezone and unit context must be preserved from the source rather than normalised without evidence
exact region/data location is customer deployment evidence, not inferred from hostname naming; any regional route change requires a new checkpoint namespace and reconciliation
dataGaps: no authorised IFS Cloud sandbox/customer tenant was available to prove token issuance, exact projection grants, data-scope isolation, denied writes or real reads
exact manufacturing/HCM/maintenance/quality/finance projections depend on installed components, release and customer configuration
no universal public pagination/delta/rate-limit/event-completeness contract was established for every projection
custom projections/fields and customer-defined data access policies are tenant-specific
regional residency and transfer controls require tenant/contract evidence before production certification
constraintsRisks: standard APIs are atomic and cross-domain consistency may span multiple calls; temporal observation windows and reconciliation are required
Entity Service APIs can expose CRUD and should not be activated merely to avoid selecting a narrower existing read surface
multi-company/site estates and acquisitions may reuse business identifiers; instance/company/site/projection namespacing is mandatory
custom fields and release updates can change schemas independently; fingerprints and review-required breaking drift are mandatory
regional outage must reduce freshness instead of silently moving data to another location without approved transfer authority
